name: snapback-web
description: Snapback landing page - All assets in one place

_guide.build: npm run assets:build optimizes everything to public/assets/
_guide.output-formats: Images → WebP + AVIF (+ blur placeholders), Videos → MP4
_guide.favicon: Enable favicon.enabled and set favicon.source to generate favicon files in /public
_guide.manifest: manifest.json tracks all conversions and source → output mapping
